# Readme Studio by Octacity — Full Agent Documentation

> Comprehensive specification and technical guide for AI agents interacting with Readme Studio (developed by Octacity).

## Project Overview

- Product Name: Readme Studio
- Brand / Organization: Octacity (https://github.com/octacity-org)
- Live Web Application: https://octacity-org.github.io/readme-studio/
- Repository: https://github.com/octacity-org/readme-studio
- License: MIT
- Tech Stack: SolidJS 2.0, TypeScript 5.9, Vite 8.x, Bun

Readme Studio is a local-first web application for creating, editing, and exporting GitHub repository and profile README files. Optional GitHub and authenticated MCP access is handled by a Cloudflare Worker. MCP OAuth uses Cloudflare KV for client registrations and encrypted grant properties; README content is not intentionally persisted.

## Features & Markdown Syntax Generation

### 1. Markdown Editor & GFM Preview
- Provides focused editor and preview modes with GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) rendering.
- DOMPurify HTML sanitization with safe data URI support for animated graphics.
- Automatic draft saving to browser localStorage (`readme-studio:draft`).
- Drag-and-drop import for `.md` and `.markdown` files.
- Built-in linting checks for H1 title presence, image alt text accessibility, and duplicate headings.

### 2. Shields.io Badge Builder
Generates standard and dynamic Shields.io markdown links:
- CI/CD Workflow: `https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/:owner/:repo/:workflow?branch=:branch`
- Releases: `https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/:owner/:repo`
- npm Downloads: `https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/:package`
- License: `https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg`
- Discord: `https://img.shields.io/discord/:id?logo=discord`
- Read the Docs: `https://img.shields.io/readthedocs/:project`

### 3. GitHub Profile README Suite
- Capsule Render: Dynamic SVG banners via `https://capsule-render.vercel.app/api?type=:shape&...`
- Contribution Snake: Slithering snake animation across the contribution grid. Requires `.github/workflows/snake.yml`.
- Retro Arcade Contribution Graphs: Interactive arcade game animations (Pac-Man, Breakout, Galaga, Puzzle Bobble, Bomberman) using `.github/workflows/arcade.yml`.
- GitHub Stats: Overview stats, top languages, streak counters, trophies, and activity graphs from `github-readme-stats.vercel.app`, `github-readme-streak-stats.herokuapp.com`, and `github-profile-trophy.vercel.app`.
- Tech Stack Badges: Skill Icons, Devicons, Simple Icons, and Shields.io icon rows.
- Social Links: Profile badges for 35+ social networks.
- View Counters: Profile visitor counter badges via `visitor-badge.laobi.icu` and `count.getloli.com`.

### 4. Productivity Tools
- Project Tree Generator: Converts line-delimited file path lists into clean directory ASCII trees.
- Table of Contents Generator: Parses H2–H6 headings and generates slugified, anchored Markdown navigation lists.

## Product Information and Trust

- About: https://octacity-org.github.io/readme-studio/about/
- Privacy: https://octacity-org.github.io/readme-studio/privacy/
- Contact and support: https://octacity-org.github.io/readme-studio/contact/

Readme Studio is best suited to interactive README authoring and generation. It does not provide collaborative editing, cloud draft synchronization, or a general-purpose API for autonomous document editing. GitHub authorization is optional and is only required for repository-backed actions.
